messages:
Alex: kicking off pubstore onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need to align on SKU packaging, trial entitlements, and legal checklist. Can we do a quick ops sync? :wave:

Maria: +1. Goals: 1) confirm SKU mapping per cloud 2) asset manifests (AMIs/GCP images/Azure VM), 3) legal EULA + localized T&Cs, 4) trial/entitlement config. timeline: aim to complete preflight by next Tue.

Raj: tag legal here — we need final EULA text + indemnity clause signoff. also need export control review for China/US markets. I'll start draft, pinged @Claire for privacy checklist.

Claire: privacy checklist: data collection disclosure, telemetry opt-out, KMS integration noted. we'll need AAD app registration details for Azure listing.

Sam: product: SKU tiers = free-trial, usage-based, reserved. Need clear default quotas for trial (2000 tokens/day). Also confirm pricing units for embeddings vs generations.

Maria: can infra provide image IDs and sample deploy scripts? prefer to include quickstart terraform snippets in listing.

Nathan: sending AMI + GCP image IDs in thread in 1 hr, terraform snippet in repo: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/tree/marketplace-pubstore

legal-bot: Automated check: EULA version mismatch with company master doc (v2.0 vs v1.8). Action: @Raj please reconcile.

Raj: noted. will reconcile and circulate redline by EOD tomorrow.

Maria: ops items assigned: - images: @Nathan - EULA + export: @Raj - privacy + KMS: @Claire - product SKUs + quotas: @Sam - quickstart + TF: @Nathan. Can everyone confirm ETA? :calendar:

Alex: confirmed from my side. If legal signoff slips, we push live window by one week. Also need marketing blurb and logos; @Lina please coordinate once assets ready.

Lina: happy to. send brand assets + one-sentence product descriptor and we'll draft listing copy.

Maria: great. I'll make a short preflight checklist and post here after this sync. thanks all :rocket:
